prompt: A vast, solemn control hall of the 2058 global network authority: tiered empty rows facing a colossal black monolithic terminal wall with a single huge round red-glowing lens at its centre, in the design of the reference terminal; cold white light, a polished floor reflecting the red lens. Empty of people. Documentary still photograph, shot on a 35mm cinema camera in available light, natural film grain, unposed and observational, photorealistic, near-future hard science fiction, worn and lived-in. No captions, no subtitles, no watermark, no legible text anywhere. Muted cold palette with a few warm practical lamps.
